item.title: Star Labs: Frontend Developer (React)
item.content:encoded: Star Labs is hiring a Frontend Developer. Strong React and TypeScript skills required. Experience with Vue is a plus. You will build responsive UIs and collaborate with designers. Good communication and attention to detail are essential.

item.title: CloudNative Inc: DevOps Engineer
item.content:encoded: DevOps Engineer at CloudNative Inc. Expertise in Kubernetes, Docker, and AWS is required. You will manage CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and monitor production systems. A strong problem-solving mindset and experience with Linux administration are essential. This is a fully remote position with a global distributed team.
